# Columbina Theme — Patch Edition
**English** | **中文**
A moonlit silver-blue glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with an editable Columbin
silver-blue glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with an editable Columbina persona.
**This is a patch, not an original theme.** The bulk of the code comes from Columbina-sn, the font p
alette from hyposelen1a, and the host/client structure from berhbro. See Credits.
## Disclaimer
This theme is pure CSS rendered by your browser, so the final look depends on your machine:
- **Glass blur** (`backdrop-filter`) needs Chromium 76+ / Edge / Chrome. Old engines, disabled hardw
are acceleration, some remote desktops, VMs or integrated-GPU drivers fall back to a flat translucen

t layer — no blur.
- **Gradient text** (`background-clip:text`) may fail to paint on a few GPU drive

rs. There is a `@supports` solid-colour fallback, but it looks different.
- **Light/dark** follows y
our system/Harness appearance (`prefers-color-scheme` and `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`), not a plugin

switch.
- **High DPI** (125% / 150% / 200%) changes how the 72px avatar, 1px borders and 2px letter-

spacing read; screenshot pixels are not CSS pixels.
- **Wide-gamut displays / colour management** ma
ke saturated purples such as `#78007a` look brighter or duller. The "same colour" never is, across s

creens.
- **Fonts**: the hero title prefers Source Han Serif / STSong and falls back to a system ser

if, which changes metrics.
- **Host wallpaper overlay**: if your Harness frontend ships its own full
-screen wallpaper layer (e.g. `#dsh-wall-layer`, opaque, `z-index:0`), it paints over this theme's `
z-index:-1` background layer. Since v0.2.2 the theme hides that layer while its own background image
is active, and restores it in plain mode.
Screenshots are illustrative, not a guarantee of pixel-identical rendering.
## What it is
A DSH theme plugin: palette, background image, glass effects, editable persona and sticker conventio

ns.
This patched edition adds a theme-takeover switch, background upload, blur/clarity sliders and a
n editable hero title.
## What's changed
| Change | Notes |
| **Theme takeover** | When two Columbina themes are installed they fight over the same tokens. Togg
le on → the other package (`dsh-columbina-theme`) is disabled through the host `pluginManager`; togg

le off → it is restored and this theme steps aside. Persisted across restarts. |
| **Background uplo
ad** | Upload from the panel; files land in `Background/` and become the anchor. Hover `×` on a thum

bnail to delete (with confirm). Never overwrites existing files, duplicates get a suffix. |
| **Blur
& clarity** | Two independent sliders: blur 0–40px (preview while dragging, persist on release; the
layer scales by `1 + radius/200` to hide the soft edge) and clarity, the positive phrasing of the v

eil opacity. |
| **Editable hero title** | The title lives in the state file and is editable from th

e panel. Empty `hero.image` hides the avatar entirely, leaving one line of text. |
| **Editable welc
ome page** | Title and a multi-line body are both editable from the panel (v0.3.0). An empty body re

nders nothing at all; an empty title falls back to the built-in line. |
| **Font palette** | Label t
okens now use hyposelen1a's palette: `#78007a` light, `#acabf2` dark, with secondary/tertiary derive

d at 0.82 / 0.6 alpha. The hero gradient follows. |
| **Viewer text colour** | The plain-text previe
w ships its own green (`#2b8a3e`) that a container-level `color` cannot beat, so it is pinned on `pr

e[class*="_plain"]`. Syntax-highlighted spans keep their own colours. |
| **Hero image cache** | The
image URL carries `?v=<path>` so `Cache-Control: max-age=300` cannot serve a stale avatar after a s

wap. |
| **Host wallpaper overlay** | Hides a host-side full-screen wallpaper layer (`#dsh-wall-laye
r`) while the theme background is active (v0.2.2). |
Everything else (persona section, sticker manifest, fenced routes, slot registration, glass CSS) is
unchanged from upstream.
## Install
Requirements: a DSH desktop or web profile that loads client plugins. Verified on **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**
; the Linux test also passed on **0.2.0-rc.2**.
`dsh plugin` needs **pnpm** on PATH. If it fails with `spawn pnpm ENOENT`, run `corepack enable pnpm
gin` needs **pnpm** on PATH. If it fails with `spawn pnpm ENOENT`, run `corepack enable pnpm` first.

## Quick start
1. A `☾ 哥伦比娅` button appears next to Settings at the sidebar foot; the same editor is also under Set

tings → 哥伦比娅 · 主题.
2. Top switches: persona / skin / **theme takeover** / stickers / proactive stick

ers / no-repeat.
3. Background block: upload, pick an anchor, drag blur and clarity.
4. `恢复默认` refil
ls the default persona draft; `重新载入` discards unsaved edits.
### When changes apply
| What | Applies |

| Persona / switches / background settings (panel save) | Immediately, next turn |
| `lib/client.js`

| Page refresh |
| `lib/index.js`, `cordis.patch.yml` | Plugin row reload or restart |
| `Backgroun
d/` add / remove / rename | Page refresh |
## Compatibility
| Item | Notes |

| Engine | Chromium 76+ (Edge / Chrome / Electron); older engines lack `backdrop-filter` |
| GPU | W

ith acceleration off, the glass degrades to a flat translucent layer |
| DPI | 100%–200% works; at 1

25% the 1px borders and 72px avatar read slightly differently |
| OS | Verified on Windows 10/11 and

Alibaba Cloud Linux; macOS untested |
| DSH | Verified on 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2; slots/APIs may

differ in other versions |
| Fonts | The hero prefers Source Han Serif / STSong, falls back to a sy

ther versions |
| Fonts | The hero prefers Source Han Serif / STSong, falls back to a system serif |
